services.text: You insure your car, your home, and your own health, but many people treat their pets as family without insuring them.

about.title: About Farmers Insurance
text: Insurance can feel confusing when you’re juggling coverage, renewals, and storm risk on the Texas Gulf Coast. At Paula Smith Insurance, we explain your options clearly and build a proposal around what you actually need, not a one-size-fits-all package.

Whether you run a restaurant, a contracting crew, a medical office, or a veterinary clinic, your coverage should match how your business actually operates. We write general liability, business owner’s policies (BOP), commercial property, commercial auto, and workers’ compensation for businesses across Harris and Galveston counties. See our commercial insurance options or request a business quote.
Ready for clearer coverage and a real local agent? Use the buttons above, complete our free quote form, or call (281) 488-8880. We’ll follow up promptly.
